# The committee will meet again

Conclosed

on seday the reipt for the amount

haid

in full. Please forward the enclosed papers to the ceanty clerk efore Friday. We received forty-two crales of apples

on the ninth of March, 1914.

Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant.

The committe will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. remain, with great respect, your obedient servant. The committee will meet again on tuesda vening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full.

Please forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk before friday

We received forty-two crates
